brief:
Pro-Palestinian demonstrators hurled milk toward US President Joe Biden during an event in Dublin, Al Jazeera English reported. The protest targeted Biden over his administration's support for Israel.

The incident occurred as Biden attended an event related to his son Hunter in the Irish capital. Details on the protesters' specific demands or the scale of the demonstration were not immediately available.
dek: Pro-Palestinian protesters hurled milk towards Joe Biden in Ireland over his support for Israel.
title: Pro-Palestinian protesters throw milk at Biden during Dublin visit
